scraped.scraped_description: Making it easy to keep an eye on the UK’s parliaments. Discover who represents you, how they’ve voted and what they’ve said in debates.

name: TheyWorkForYou
tagline: Hansard and Official Reports for the UK Parliament, Scottish Parliament, and Northern Ireland Assembly - done right
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
news_articles: Guardian: TheyWorkForYou tracks parliamentary voting records
BBC News: How to track your MP's voting record
Reuters: UK civic tech platform monitors parliament
academic_citations: Lusoli, W., & Ward, S. (2005). 'Politics is just a click away': The impact of the internet on political engagement and participation. Journal of Legislative Studies, 11(3-4), 405-424.
Macintosh, A., & Whyte, A. (2008). Evaluating how e-participation changes local democracy. eGovernment Institute, Edinburgh Napier University.
policy_outcomes: Increased parliamentary transparency and public access to voting records
Enhanced citizen engagement with legislative processes
outcome_methodology: observational tracking of platform usage and parliamentary engagement metrics
published_performance_metrics: Platform tracks 2M+ annual visitors, 100K+ registered users, comprehensive Hansard database coverage
documented_limitations: Dependent on data feed quality from parliamentary sources
Coverage gaps for historical records prior to 2004
jurisdictional_scope: United Kingdom (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland)
failure_modes: Data feed interruptions from parliamentary sources
curation_criteria: Official parliamentary records from Hansard and official reports; automated parsing and indexing of legislative documents
contributor_governance: mySociety-managed with community contributions via GitHub; volunteer-driven development
